title: ze_Baboonpox_escape
description:
Port of my 2nd CSGO ZE map, made in 2022.
Set in the real life setting of London's East End.

After escaping Wuhan via helicopter you land in the East End of London. There's a new virus turning people into baboon like zombies! Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to once again investigate the source of the virus so we can put a stop to it! Navigate your way through London whilst keeping the infected at bay, then extract back to base with the intel you recover.
